target_customer: B2B SaaS customer success and implementation teams that onboard customers
problem: Teams run customer onboarding in spreadsheets, email and generic project tools. Onboard gives shared launch plans, a customer portal and automation.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with tiers from $25 to $1,000 per month

founders.name: Jeff Epstein
prior_employers: Ambassador Software (founder, acquired by Intrado in 2018)
founders.background_notes: Named as CEO in the February 2021 press release. The YC page names a 'Jeffrey Douglas' with the same Ambassador history, so the name may differ; the press release is used.

founders.name: Will Stevenson
founders.background_notes: Press release: ran operations and success teams for almost a decade and helped sell three companies. YC page says he led companies involved in $660M+ in acquisitions.

founders.name: Matt Majewski
founders.background_notes: Named as cofounder in the February 2021 press release; not on the YC page.

competitors.name: Google Docs, email, Asana and monday.com
competitors.what: generic tools teams used for onboarding

competitors.name: GuideCX
competitors.funding_then: $25M Series B announced 2022-02-02 (led by Meritech); earlier $10M Series A

competitors.name: Rocketlane
competitors.funding_then: $3M seed co-led by Matrix Partners India and Nexus Venture Partners, reported 2021-06-23

technical_complexity.rationale: A workflow and portal SaaS with CRM integrations is standard CRUD and integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Customer data and templates create some lock in, but several funded rivals sold the same product.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Project tools were the default alternative. Onboard stayed independent until Zelkova Ventures bought a majority stake in August 2025.

market_need_then: The 2021 press release says onboarding teams relied on Google Docs, email, Asana or monday.com, and the founders cited poor customer launches as the pain.

branding.domain_note: Uses onboard.io; other companies named OnBoard (board management software) share the name.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and problem focused ('Stop running customer onboarding in spreadsheets').

brand_strength.rationale: A generic word shared by an unrelated board software company; no press about the brand itself found.

outcome_analysis: Onboard was founded by Ambassador alumni, raised a $1.25M pre-seed in February 2021 and joined YC in Winter 2022. It stayed a small SaaS in a category with better funded rivals such as GuideCX and Rocketlane, and in August 2025 Zelkova Ventures, an early investor, took a majority stake.
notes: The StreetInsider release returned 403, so the August 2025 majority stake comes from search results of several outlets (StreetInsider, Digital Journal, InvestorWire); deal terms unknown. The YC directory lists the company as Active, so the exit is a majority stake and not a full sale. Aggregators list totals of $500K to $1.75M including a $0.5M YC note in March 2022; unverified. The competitor sources for GuideCX and Rocketlane come from search results and were not opened. The YC page founder name 'Jeffrey Douglas' conflicts with the press release.
